State 3 reads $1AC2,X. A positive value is passed to $4342 and decremented. Zero is replaced by $80; a negative value has bit 7 masked off and is passed to $4368. If the stored value is below $85, increment it; otherwise call $4B0E with A=$20 and jump to $5DB9 with A=3. On the continuing path, load A=3 and use the sign of $97DF to jump to $43F0 when negative or $43A2 otherwise.
